description: This file contains dataset service functions for managing datasets and dataset rows, including CRUD operations, CSV parsing, reordering, and related utilities, within a server-side application.

methods.name: getAllDatasets
methods.description: Fetches all datasets for a given workspace, with optional pagination, including row counts.

methods.name: getDataset
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dataset by ID, including its rows, handling missing sequence numbers.

methods.name: reorderDatasetRow
methods.description: Reorders dataset rows by updating their sequence numbers within a transaction.

methods.name: _readCSV
methods.description: Reads CSV data from a stream into an array of results.

methods.name: _csvToDatasetRows
methods.description: Converts CSV string(s) into dataset rows, assigning sequence numbers, and saving them.

methods.name: createDataset
methods.description: Creates a new dataset, optionally importing CSV data into dataset rows.

methods.name: deleteDataset
methods.description: Deletes a dataset and all associated dataset rows.

methods.name: addDatasetRow
methods.description: Adds a new row to a dataset, optionally importing CSV data.

methods.name: changeUpdateOnDataset
methods.description: Updates the 'updatedDate' timestamp of a dataset.

methods.name: deleteDatasetRow
methods.description: Deletes a dataset row within a transaction.

methods.name: patchDeleteRows
methods.description: Deletes multiple dataset rows by IDs and updates related datasets.
